description: Renders ONE multi-cut clip of up to 15 seconds with native stereo audio from up to 9 reference plates, via the MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo node on a local ComfyUI. Builds the <Picture N> reference-binding clause deterministically, snaps duration to H3's 17k+5 frame grid at 24fps, and hands the whole timed shot list to the model as one prompt.
